name: Moloch Iron-Forged
identity: Daemon-smith siege engineers, iron legionaries and soul-furnace war-engines. Thralls are fuel: shovel one into an engine to supercharge it. Bunker-busting guns ignore cover on objectives and in ruins.

rules.name: Feed the Furnace · Siege-Masters
rules.description: Feed the Furnace: when a Class 4–5 Moloch unit activates, you may remove 1 model from a friendly [EXPENDABLE] Class 1 unit within 3″: this activation its weapons gain [RELENTLESS] (re-roll Wound rolls) and [ONSLAUGHT 1]. Siege-Masters: Moloch ranged weapons gain [IGNORES COVER] against units within 3″ of an objective or in Dense terrain.

rules.name: Gamble — Red-Line the Boilers
rules.description: When a Class 3–5 unit is selected to Shoot or Fight: its weapons get +2 Attacks; afterwards it suffers 1 Fatal Wound for each natural 1 rolled to Hit (max D3+1). (Risk: durability (dice).)

detachments.name: Grand Siege
detachments.playstyle: Artillery and heavy squads grind fortified positions.

rules.name: Bunker-Busters
rules.description: Siege-Masters also applies to units in Light terrain; [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons do not suffer the −1 to Hit.

enhancements.name: Siege-Lens
enhancements.description: **Iron-Smith Forgemaster** only. The attached unit gets +1 PEN with ranged weapons.

enhancements.name: Daemon-Bound Shells
enhancements.description: **Infernal Bombard** only. +1 Damage against units in Cover.

stratagems.name: Shattering Bombardment
stratagems.turn: A [SHRAPNEL] weapon hits a Class 1–2 unit
stratagems.effect: It suffers −2″ MOV until the End of Round.

stratagems.name: Creeping Barrage
stratagems.effect: Re-roll Hit rolls against units within 3″ of an objective.

stratagems.name: Entrench
stratagems.effect: +1 ARM (to 3+ cap) until the End of Round.

detachments.name: Daemon-Forge
detachments.playstyle: Engines everywhere, smiths keeping them alive.

rules.name: Anvil of the Daemon
rules.description: Class 3–5 units within 6″ of a friendly Leader heal 1 MIGHT at the End of Round.

enhancements.name: Hammer of Moloch
enhancements.description: **Daemon-Smith Overseer** only. Demonic Anvil Repair heals D3+1.

stratagems.name: Stoke the Fires
stratagems.turn: A Class 4–5 unit is fed to the Furnace
stratagems.effect: It also gets +2″ MOV this activation.

stratagems.name: Daemonic Fury
stratagems.turn: A Class 3–5 unit is selected to Fight

detachments.name: Iron Within
detachments.playstyle: Iron legionaries and siege-guard holding the line.

rules.name: Iron Within, Iron Without
rules.description: Once per round per unit, when targeted, incoming PEN −1 and re-roll ARM saves of 1 for that attack.

enhancements.name: Bastion-Seal
enhancements.description: **Iron-Warden Champion** only. The attached unit has WARD 5+.

enhancements.name: Ironclad Pauldrons
enhancements.description: **Iron-Forged Legionaries** only. +1 ARM (to 3+ cap) against PEN 0 and −1.

stratagems.name: Smog and Smoke
stratagems.effect: Friendly Class 1–2 units within 9″ of a Class 4–5 unit are [STEALTH] until the End of Round.
